comment: Ecosystem-tool arms (the second arm class). Every entry is a tool a user would reach for, listed with the exact argv the runner executes - no shell, no string interpolation beyond {input} and {script_dir}. Reports produced from here carry arm_class=tool and are never rendered in the same table as a parity arm (ROADMAP 7.1). A tool is added only after its argv has been verified against the installed version and recorded here.

pyfastx-stat.notes: The CLI subcommand is `stat`, not `stats` (checked against pyfastx 2.3.1 with `pyfastx --help`); it prints per-file statistics to stdout.

r-prcomp.notes: The R parity arm deliberately hand-writes its power iteration; this arm is the call a user would actually make. Both read the same matrix file, so the difference is the implementation, not the input handling.
